scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = './src'; const dist = './dist'; if (!fs.existsSync(dist)) fs.mkdirSync(dist, { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync(src).filter(f => f.endsWith('.css')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, f), path.join(dist, f)))"
